title: Time Converter
description:
Convert 9999 seconds into hours, minutes, and seconds. Print the result in the format `H hours, M minutes, S seconds`.

**Expected output:**
```
2 hours, 46 minutes, 39 seconds
```
hint: Use // and % to extract hours, minutes, and seconds. hours = total // 3600, remainder = total % 3600, minutes = remainder // 60, seconds = remainder % 60.
